name: Decompos_It
shortDescription: Android app that detects objects with CameraX, then web-scrapes decomposition times from an environmental database to show how long the item takes to decompose.
description:
ICS4U environmental-assignment Android app: snap a photo with CameraX, run real-time object labeling, then web-scrape decomposition times for the detected item from an environmental database.

Highlights:
- Built with Android Studio + CameraX for camera capture and live preview.
- Real-time item labeling via on-device computer vision.
- Web-scraping pipeline pulls decomposition times (months/years) keyed to object class, with notes on factors like paper type, moisture, temperature, and microbial activity.
- Designed an intuitive UI optimized for backwards compatibility across Android versions.
